title: Distance to a property
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set, let $\beta$ be a finite set, let $f:\Omega\to\beta$, and let $P$ be a property of functions from $\Omega$ to $\beta$. If at least one such function satisfies $P$, define the distance from $f$ to $P$ as the relative Hamming distance from $f$ to a closest function satisfying $P$.
